title: Air Force takes over Navy UFO investigations

tellings.quote: people were having UFO encounters and the Navy personnel would get really angry because uh Air Force people would come on the Navy ships and throw their weight around and take over the investigations

plain: From the late 1940s through the 1950s, when sailors had UFO encounters, Air Force personnel would come aboard Navy ships, throw their weight around and take over the investigations, which made the Navy men angry. The UFO researcher Richard Dolan tells this on Michels' show, passing on what he heard from a man named Donald Kho. If true, it would mean the Air Force was quietly taking control of UFO reports from the other services.
